meta.description: Weekly review of reliability/recurrence.yaml against what has actually failed. Reads GET lanes:8081/recurrence, which is read-only by construction: the endpoint never collects, so it cannot write to the read-only audit mount. Warns on three separate things — a pattern seen twice with no harness fix, a disposition expiring, and a source nobody has collected from. The third matters because a blind source reports zero and a quiet week reports zero, and only one of those is good news.
